llm/athene-70b-0725.tagline: Open 70B chat model tuned for instructions
llm/athene-70b-0725.overview: Athene 70B is an open-weights chat model from NexusFlow, fine-tuned from Meta's Llama 3 to follow instructions more reliably. Because its weights are open, you can download and run it yourself instead of relying on a paid API. It aims to improve general instruction-following over the base Llama 3.
capabilities: Open weights you can download and self-host
useCases: Students who want a capable open chat model to run locally or on their own server
Developers experimenting with Llama-3-based fine-tunes without API costs
howTo: Visit the model page on Hugging Face at huggingface.co/Nexusflow/Athene-70B
Request or accept any access terms and download the open weights
Load the model with a framework like Hugging Face Transformers or vLLM
Send a chat-style prompt and read the model's response
Note that a 70B model needs substantial GPU memory to run

example.label: Download from Hugging Face (Python)
example.code:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer

model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Nexusflow/Athene-70B")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("Nexusflow/Athene-70B")

goodToKnow: This is a 70-billion-parameter model, so running it well requires significant GPU hardware.
It is fine-tuned from Llama 3, so Llama licensing and usage terms apply.
